profile.headline: Electrical Engineering
about: I study Electrical Engineering at Telkom University, focusing on industrial automation turning sensors, signals, and control systems into things that actually work in the field.
My work combines technical exploration with a builder mindset understand the problem, test the system, and share what actually works.
